nuggets.text: Michael Desormeaux played both quarterback and defensive back for Louisiana before becoming the Ragin' Cajuns' head coach.
Ragin' Cajuns coach Michael Desormeaux is a distant cousin of horse racing jockey Kent Desormeaux.
QB Lunch Winfield once went 14 of 15 against South Alabama, a Ragin' Cajuns record for completion rate.
The Ragin' Cajuns' punter, Mason Golding, hails from Perth, Australia.
Cajun Field is nicknamed The Swamp and sits in a sunken natural bowl, so many fans walk down to their seats.
Cajun Field needs four 60-horsepower pumps and a big drainage system to handle Louisiana rainstorms.
After the 2020 Sun Belt title game went unplayed, Lafayette's mayor-president proclaimed the Ragin' Cajuns sole champions.
The Ragin' Cajuns were officially the Bulldogs until 1974, though the Ragin' Cajuns name was in use back in the 1960s.
Freshman Darrell Smith ran for 84 yards and two touchdowns on just 10 carries in the 38-7 opener against Lamar.
Brent Gordon Jr. led the Ragin' Cajuns with seven tackles and added an interception in the win over Lamar.
